title: Managed Database: backup storage rate
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database backup storage rate is specified by contracted tier. Backup storage outside included retention; USD per GB-month.

| Contracted tier | Backup storage rate |
|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 0.026 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 0.026 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 0.026 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 0.026 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 0.026 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 0.026 |

## Tier comparison
For backup storage rate, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 0.026.
